text:
ryan: Need a short partner briefing + invite that cuts down back-and-forth. Goal: 8 seats, 2-week private beta, minimal negotiation. Can we lock copy + acceptance gates today?

asha: Keep it minimal: single POC, run a 3-prompt smoke test at start and end, opt-in to share redacted traces. Time commitment <= 3 hours.

trent: Add an explicit "we won’t do" line: no custom quantization, no kernel/runtime edits, no infra swaps. Put that in the first paragraph so sales doesn't argue.

kelly: Incentive model: $350 + $1k infra credit, plus a 45m post-beta tuning session and a short perf summary. That usually converts.

legal: Include short data-sharing language: partners consent to share redacted request/response samples and perf traces for debugging and product research; full raw logs only by separate agreement.

ryan: Success criteria draft: 1) onboard >=6 partners, 2) p95 latency <= 300ms on our dedicated harness, 3) median embed sim >= 0.9 on canonical prompts, 4) at least one actionable tuning change implemented.

asha: Measurement flow: partners run 3 canonical prompts on day0 and day14, fill a 6-question form, optional 30m interview. We'll compute embed sim delta + 3-point human ratings per prompt.

trent: Risk gate: any partner-reported P0 regression pauses wave onboarding until triage. Also call out "no guaranteed hotfix SLA" for non-P0 issues.

kelly: Draft short invite blurb: 
"Join a 2-week private beta (8 seats). Receive $350 + infra credit, a 30-60m onboarding call, and a post-beta tuning session. Requirements: single POC, run a 3-prompt smoke test at start and end, and opt-in to share redacted traces. Out of scope: custom quantizations, kernel/runtime code changes, infra swaps. Expected time commitment: <=3 hours."

mailer-bot: Reminder: outgoing invite quota = 420/hr. Stagger sends across windows to avoid throttling. :robot_face:

ryan: Action items: Asha -> finalize canonical prompts + short form, Trent -> add OOS line to invite, Kelly -> confirm stipend/credit numbers and post-beta deliverables, Legal -> provide final data-sharing sentence. I'll post final invite to #product-review tomorrow AM.

asha: Quick ask: can eng ops set up a per-partner read-only dashboard for partners who opt-in? That increases transparency and uptake.

trent: I can spin up a small dashboard (p95/p99, token counts, embed sim) if partners opt-in. Need the opt-in flag in the invite.

ryan: Great. Let's keep copy tight and make expectations explicit to avoid churn.
